ModMetaData.name: Auto-Blink Caraven Speed
ModMetaData.author: ErtzFiend
ModMetaData.description: Experimental candidate, not verified in game. When all walking caravan members have an active profile-bearing AutoBlink source, travel time is multiplied by 0.001, rounded and clamped to one tick. Capability is not a check of current blink permission or costs. Includes formation preview. Requires Harmony and AutoBlink.
